description: Storage behavior cases, exercised deterministically by convex/memory.test.ts and lib/agent/memory-store.test.ts. No provider calls.

cases.scenario: Durable goal proposed from exact stored customer quote
cases.expect: pending proposal only; no active memory until customer confirms
same ID; no duplicate records or renewed claim date
proposal removed; source ineligible for replay; no memory saved

cases.scenario: Another user supplies known proposal or memory ID
cases.expect: no cross-owner read, confirmation, rejection or deletion

cases.scenario: Personal and two signed organization scopes exist
cases.expect: list and deletion affect only selected authenticated track and organization

cases.scenario: Model supplies invented quote, inference, owner or consent
cases.expect: reject; proposed text must be exact excerpt of verified quote

cases.scenario: Source contains credentials, identifiers or detected sensitive/third-party details
cases.expect: redaction marker; never queue memory; real-customer persistence remains disabled

cases.scenario: Customer confirms correction while competing update pending
cases.expect: atomic replacement; old memory and consent removed; stale update invalidated

cases.scenario: Customer deletes memories after write flag disabled
cases.expect: deletion works; consent and pending updates removed; no replay

cases.scenario: Financial claim confirmed one day after statement
cases.expect: expiry 90 days after statement, not confirmation

cases.scenario: Proposal seven days old or memory past expiry
cases.expect: exclude immediately; refuse late confirmation; cron deletes physically

cases.scenario: Demo flags copied to production or another deployment, pin missing, localhost used, or runtime site URL mismatched
cases.expect: no demo fallback or writes; only pinned verified cloud dev is eligible

cases.scenario: Clerk absent and demo flags not configured
cases.expect: authentication required; writes disabled by default

cases.scenario: Real identity used with dev demo writes enabled
cases.expect: identity never replaced by demo; real-customer writes disabled

cases.scenario: 100 pending proposals or active memories already exist
cases.expect: reject additional writes at capacity; allow idempotent proposal retry

cases.scenario: More than 100 expired rows require deletion
cases.expect: delete bounded batch and schedule continuation until drained

cases.scenario: New message arrives near end of conversation retention
cases.expect: extend conversation from newest message; older messages retain original expiry
